identification.source: Sprengel 1830, vol. 2, p. 510 (Comm. III cap. XXXIV): 'De dictamno Dioscoridis cretico nunquam exstitit controversia ... Est Origanum Dictamnus L., cuius iconem fere primam Dodonaeus exhibuit.' Same chapter: ψευδοδίκταμνον = Marrubium pseudodictamnus L.; third dictamnon conjectured as Thymus mastichina L. (these are the chapter's other kinds, not rivals to δίκταμνον). | Fraas 1845, Synopsis plantarum florae classicae, pp. 181-182: 'Orig. Dictamnus L., ächter Diptam' = δίκταμνος Hippocr., Theophr. 9,16, Diosc. 3,37; modern name στοματόχορτον; 'Nur auf Kreta bis jetzt.' Osbaldeston 2000, ch. 3-37 DIKTAMNON: 'SUGGESTED' list gives both Dictamnus albus / D. fraxinella (White Dittany) and Origanum dictamnus / Dictamnus creticus / Amaracus dictamnus (Dittany of Crete). (https://archive.org/details/BIUSante_dioscsprengelx02/page/n511/mode/1up ; https://archive.org/details/synopsisplantaru00fraa/page/n226/mode/1up ; https://archive.org/details/synopsisplantaru00fraa/page/n227/mode/1up ; https://archive.org/details/dioscorides-de-materia-medica-2000-english)
